description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a major North American fast-food chain specializing in Southern-style fried chicken, located in a Chilliwack commercial strip at Unit 101 on Marshall Road. It has been operating at this location since November 2019 and offers takeout service. The wheelchair-accessible premises and on-site washrooms make it a serviceable stop for cyclists passing through Chilliwack.
